quest.guhs.mika.challenge: NYEG! Want that little guh back? Then beat me at rock-paper-scissors. Three times in a row! Nyeg nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.mika.play: NYEG! Again? Off you chonk, then.
quest.guhs.mika.won: NYEG HEHE! I picked %s. Back to zero, you chonky thing!
quest.guhs.sled.start: Guh... nyeg, my sled is broken! I need a sled runner (guh caves), a guh jingle bell (guh villages) and a pink ribbon (the tailor).
quest.guhs.sled.thanks: Wheee, CHONK! It works again! Take this sled and my sled builder's book - build your own wahoog track!
quest.guhs.sled.unlocked: You can now craft sled rails (the book stays in the recipe grid).
quest.guhs.sled.done: Ding-a-ling! Nyeg nyeg, have fun on the rails!
quest.guhs.mika.vads_reveal: Nyeg hehe... as long as you don't know the secret CHONK gesture, you'll NEVER beat me. Oops. Nyeg. I shouldn't have said that...
quest.guhs.next.camp: follow the Mika Tracker Compass to the Mika Camp in the Guhmension (hold it to see the distance)
quest.guhs.next.back_to_vadsig: bring Guhbert back to Mother Chonky at the Chonky Shrine
quest.guhs.next.picnic: follow the cake crumbs to a Guh Picnic and walk over the blanket to find the cake
quest.guhs.next.balloons: bring 3 guh balloons (picnic chests, or craft them from pink wool + string) and the cake to Mother Chonky
quest.guhs.swallowed: Mother Chonky swallowed you! This is your spot in her belly: your very own guhbelly. Blow the belly whistle or press G to go back.
quest.guhs.kermis.hello: NYEG! Welcome to the Guh Fair! Every lap on the roller coaster = one fair ticket. Look at all the stuff I've got for tickets... wahoog!
quest.guhs.kermis.first: WHEEEEE! Your first lap on the Guh Fair roller coaster! A prize bag for you: balloons, cheese honey, crystals and 2 extra fair tickets. Chonk!
quest.guhs.verstop.hello: NYEG! Up for some hide-and-guh? My buddies are hiding in the house below us. Easy, medium or hard? Wahoog!
quest.guhs.verstop.running: Shhh... someone's already seeking! Want to help?
quest.guhs.verstop.broken: Nyeg... my house is broken, I can't find any hiding spots anymore.
quest.guhs.verstop.go: There are %s guhs hidden (%s). Right-click when you find one. Good luck! The pink exit takes you back.
quest.guhs.verstop.not_playing: This guh is hiding... ask the Hidey Guh on the roof if you can join in!
quest.guhs.verstop.won: WAHOOG! All guhs found in %s! You get %s hide-and-guh ticket(s).
quest.guhs.verstop.stopped: You stop seeking (%s of %s found). See you next time!
quest.guhs.verstop.hint.floor: Hint: there's still a guh on the %s, in the %s of the house.
quest.guhs.verstop.hint.lights: Hint: in one room the lights went out and the windows went dark. No guh hiding there anymore!
quest.guhs.verstop.hint.sniff: Hint: hear that? One of the guhs keeps sniffling...
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.confirm: Psst... want a hint? Then I'll make a guh glow for a moment. But careful: your time won't count for your record anymore (you still get your tickets). Click again if you're sure!
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.given: The Hint Guh makes a guh glow for %s. Look quick!
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.wait: Nyeg, hang on... I'll have another hint in %s seconds.
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.nogame: Hi! I'm the Hint Guh. During hide-and-guh you can ask me for a hint every minute. Ask the Hidey Guh on the roof to play!
quest.guhs.verstop.tip.norecord: You used a hint, so this time doesn't count for your record.
quest.guhs.reis.discovered: Toot toot! You discovered Travel Guh '%s'. Right-click me to travel to every Travel Guh you know. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.reis.only_guhmension: Nyeg... Travel Guhs only travel within the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.reis.renamed: This Travel Guh is now called '%s'
quest.guhs.poort.halt: HALT! Who goes there? Only friends of the guhs may enter the King's castle. Prove you're a true guh friend!
quest.guhs.poort.hint1: Psst... true guh friends are really good at chonking. Being nice and lazy, you know. See that little bench over there?
quest.guhs.poort.hint2: A true guh friend knows the secret guh word. It starts with an N... and sounds like a happy guh: N-y-e-...
quest.guhs.poort.hint3: Go sit nice and chonky on the bench for half a minute. Or say the secret word every guh says when it's happy (in chat)!
quest.guhs.poort.friend: Welcome back, guh friend! The King is expecting you. NYEG!
quest.guhs.poort.welcome_lazy: I've never seen anyone sit so chonkily... You really are a guh friend! Go on in. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.poort.welcome_word: NYEG! That's the secret guh word! You're a true guh friend. Welcome to the King's castle!
quest.guhs.poort.pushed: Whoa there! First prove you're a guh friend (talk to the gatekeepers).
quest.guhs.reis.picked_up: You picked up Travel Guh '%s'. Put it down somewhere in the Guhmension: that'll be its new travel point.
quest.guhs.minigame.busy: Nyeg, you're still busy with another game! Finish that one first, then you can join in here. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.minigame.dropped: Your pockets are full: %sx %s is lying on the ground right in front of you!
quest.guhs.shop.busy: Just a moment, guh! I'm still helping another customer. You're next!
quest.guhs.beauty.hello_first: WAHOOG, a new face! Welcome to the Guh Beauty Theater. Here we dress up guhs for the Chonk Pageant: I give a theme, you pick clothes from the loaner wardrobe and the model walks the catwalk. The jury gives points, you get show rosettes. Ready?
quest.guhs.beauty.hello: There you are again, top stylist! Another round of chonky glamour?
quest.guhs.beauty.running: Shhh, a show is on! Grab a seat in the stands and clap along. You're up after!
quest.guhs.beauty.busy_self: You're already in the show! Dress your model (click the model or a loaner wardrobe).
quest.guhs.beauty.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my stage anymore. No stage, no show!
quest.guhs.beauty.no_own_guh: I don't see your own guh anywhere! Bring your tame guh along (close by), or pick one of my models.
quest.guhs.beauty.start: Showtime! %s is ready on stage. Three rounds, three themes. Make it chonky!
quest.guhs.beauty.dress_help: Click a piece of clothing to dress the model. Wardrobe closed? Click the model or a loaner wardrobe. Done? Click 'Hit the Catwalk!'
quest.guhs.beauty.walk: A round of applause for %s! The theme: %s. Look at those little hips wiggle!
quest.guhs.beauty.walk_naked: Uh... %s is walking the catwalk without any clothes! Wasn't the theme %s?!
quest.guhs.beauty.pose: %s strikes a pose for the jury... WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beauty.extase: The jury is ecstatic! They're standing on their cushions clapping!
quest.guhs.beauty.finale: End of the show! Total: %s of %s points. You won %s show rosettes (%s of them bonus).
quest.guhs.beauty.first: Your very first show! The Show Guh has a present: 4 extra show rosettes, balloons and fried cheese nibbles.
quest.guhs.beauty.best: Your record stays at %s points. Even chonkier next time!
quest.guhs.beauty.stopped: The show has stopped. You keep your %s show rosette(s). See you next time!
quest.guhs.beauty.publiek: Shhh, I'm watching the show! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.vadsma.perfect: Look at that: %s for %s! A perfect fit, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.vadsma.good: %s for %s? Quite neat. Not perfect, but chonky enough.
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.vadsma.off: %s for %s?! Nyeg! That fits like a cheese nibble in a birdcage.
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.glitterguh.miss: No hat?! A bald guh head is not a look, darling!
Nothing on the eyes? Glasses, darling, GLASSES! The eyes are the windows to the chonk!
A bare neck! Where's the bow? Where's the drama?
No outfit? That round little guh tummy is begging for one!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.knabbel.own: %s is a real sweetie. Your own guh always gets an extra nibble from Granny!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.knabbel.showste: Ooh, a Showstar piece: %s! Granny's heart melts like cheese in the fryer!
quest.guhs.beauty.reason.knabbel.piece: And look: %s! Grandpa Guh used to have one just like it. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.hello: I'm Miss Chonksley. I watch the theme: every piece of clothing has to fit. Strict but chonky!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.naked: No clothes? Nyeg. One point, for the walking.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.low: That has very little to do with %s, dear.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.high: Neatly within the theme %s. I'm impressed!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.vadsma.top: PERFECT %s! My monocle just popped out!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.hello: Mr. Glitterguh, charmed. I love complete outfits and clothes that go together.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.naked: A naked guh on MY catwalk? I'm breaking out in glitter hives!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.low: Everything's missing! Hat, glasses, bow, outfit: finish it!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.mid: Cute, but it could be more complete. Head, eyes, neck AND body!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.high: What a complete picture, darling! Almost glitterproof.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.glitterguh.top: COMPLETE! MATCHING! This is a LOOK! I'm done for!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.hello: I'm Granny Nibbles. I give points with my heart. Your own guh or a Showstar piece? Extra cute!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.naked: Oh dearie, he must be cold. Still, a nibble for being brave.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.low: I still think he's sweet. Here, a little cheese nibble.
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.mid: What a lovely chonky thing. Granny is pleased!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.high: Oh, my old guh heart! What a sweetie!
quest.guhs.beauty.jury.knabbel.top: WAHOOG! Granny is crying with joy! Ten nibbles!
quest.guhs.race.hello_new: VROOM VROOM, NYEG! Welcome to the Guh Racetrack! I'll lend you a racing guh: 3 laps through all the glowing rings, over the bridge and right through the big guh head. The WAHOOG pads give you a boost! You don't need to bring anything, chonk.
quest.guhs.race.hello: Back again? My racing guhs are warmed up and have finished their cheese nibbles. Beat your ghost! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.hello_busy: Shhh, there's a race on right now! Watch from the stands and shout real loud: WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.busy: %s is racing now (lap %s of %s). Wait a bit, or cheer from the stands!
quest.guhs.race.broken: Nyeg... my racetrack is broken, I can't find the rings anymore.
quest.guhs.race.go: Here's your racing guh! Hold on tight... on your marks...
quest.guhs.race.go_go: Why are you standing here chatting with me? RACE! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.controls: W = run (your guh keeps picking up speed), mouse = steer, S = brake, shift = dismount (then you have 5 seconds to hop back on). Through all the rings, in order, and stay on the track!
quest.guhs.race.ghost_on: Your record ghost is racing along again. Ooooooh...
quest.guhs.race.ghost_off: No ghost this time: just you and the racetrack.
quest.guhs.race.shop: The jockey outfit! Only here, only for race prizes. Then your guh will be the fastest-looking guh in the Guhmension.
quest.guhs.race.off: You got off your racing guh! Hop back on within %s seconds (right-click your racing guh), or the race is over.
quest.guhs.race.missed: Nyeg! You skipped a ring. Go back through %s first!
quest.guhs.race.reset: Oopsie! Back to the last ring...
quest.guhs.race.off_track: Nyeg! No cutting corners over the grass, chonk!
quest.guhs.race.result: Over the line in %s (laps: %s). %s! You get %s race prize(s).
quest.guhs.race.first_record: Your first race time: %s. From now on your ghost races along!
quest.guhs.race.record: NEW PERSONAL RECORD: %s (was %s)! From now on your ghost rides this race. +2 race prizes
quest.guhs.race.first: Your very first guh race! A welcome bag: 4 extra race prizes and a handful of cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.track_record: TRACK RECORD! %s raced the Guh Racetrack in %s: first place on the scoreboard! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.ended.gave_up: You got off: race over. The racing guh trots back to the pit stop.
quest.guhs.race.ended.too_late: Six minutes and still not home? The racing guh is tired, nyeg. Race over!
quest.guhs.race.niveau.makkelijk: Easy: a calm racing guh, and if you fall off the track I'll put you back just a little bit.
quest.guhs.race.niveau.lastig: Hard! A super fast but stubborn racing guh, Mika Snatchers along the track, and the SILVER WAHOOG pads don't work. Good luck, chonk!
quest.guhs.race.reset_makkelijk: Oopsie! Back just a little bit...
quest.guhs.race.goud_on: The golden ghost is racing along again. Can you beat the track record?
quest.guhs.mika_mep.hello_first: NYEG! A new whacker! The Mikas keep popping out of my board... Grab my Mika whacking hammer and whack them back into their holes! Up for a game? WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.hello: There you are again! The Mikas are getting cheeky. Another game of whacking?
quest.guhs.mika_mep.running: Shhh, %s is whacking! %s seconds left. Go sit nice and chonky in the stands, you're up after!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.running_you: Why are you talking to me? WHACK! The Mikas are escaping!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.broken: Nyeg... my board is broken, I can't find the holes anymore.
quest.guhs.mika_mep.go: Here's your Mika whacking hammer! Stand on the board and left-click the Mikas. Golden Mika = jackpot. And whatever you do: DON'T WHACK THE GUH!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help1: Whack-a-Mika: 60 seconds, and the Mikas pop up faster and faster. Left-click them with the whacking hammer!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help2: A Mika is 10 points, a golden Mika 50. Every 5 in a row your combo goes up (up to x5)!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help3: Sometimes a guh pops up. DON'T whack it: minus 25 and your combo is gone. Leave it alone and you get 5 points. A Mika that escapes or a whack into an empty hole: combo gone.
quest.guhs.mika_mep.help4: Your score earns you whack coins, and with those you buy the Mika Hunter outfit for your guh. The three best whackers in the world float by the scoreboard wall. You never need your own stuff: while whacking you don't get tired or hurt. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.end: TIME! Your score: %s points (%s Mikas, %s golden, %s guhs whacked by accident, best combo %s).
quest.guhs.mika_mep.coins: You get %s whack coin(s)! The whacking hammer goes back to the Whack Guh.
quest.guhs.mika_mep.first: Your very first game! As a thank-you: %s extra whack coins and a bag of cheese nibbles. Chonk!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.best: Your record stays at %s points. Keep whacking, chonk!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.stop.left: You walked away from the whacking board... the game is over (no whack coins). I'll take the whacking hammer back!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.stop.stopped: Stopped. I'll take the whacking hammer back. See you soon!
quest.guhs.mika_mep.stop.gone: The game of Whack-a-Mika has stopped: the whacking hammer is back with the Whack Guh.
quest.guhs.disco.title.dubbel.sub: two colors per beat now, nyeg!
quest.guhs.disco.hello: YO, WAHOOG! Welcome to the Guh Disco! Pick a song: I play the colors right on the beat and you dance them back. Ready to make your chonk swing?
quest.guhs.disco.busy: Nyeg, the floor is taken! Watch closely and learn from the pros... you're up soon.
quest.guhs.disco.dancing: Hey, you're dancing! Back to the floor, the beat won't wait!
quest.guhs.disco.broken: Nyeg... my dance floor is broken, I can't find my four tile colors.
quest.guhs.disco.go: Song: %1$s (%2$s). Listen to the beat: on every beat a color flashes and a tone plays. Then step on the same colors in the same order! Every round adds one color. The tempo is just the song's... but soon the colors come on double beats. One wrong step and the music stops. The golden cross is safe: you can always stand on that.
quest.guhs.disco.first: Your first dance at the Guh Disco! A welcome present: 4 disco coins and a cheese nibble shake. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.disco.left: You stepped off the dance floor: the music stops!
quest.guhs.disco.done: The music stops! You danced %s colors in a row and get %s disco coin(s).
quest.guhs.disco.record_first: Your first record on %2$s: %1$s colors! Will you make the top 3 above the podium? WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.disco.no_best: No record yet: not a single color right. Next time: listen to the tones, guh!
quest.guhs.disco.title.ready.sub: %1$s - %2$s beats per minute - listen to the beat
quest.guhs.golf.hello1: NYEG! Welcome to Guh Mini Golf! Nine holes, one ball, zero cheese nibbles (I ate them). Up for a round? Wahoog!
quest.guhs.golf.hello2: Fore! Oops, you only shout that when a ball comes flying... I mean: hi! Want to golf? I'll lend you my very prettiest club.
quest.guhs.golf.hello3: Did you know a guh golf ball is really a guh rolled up in a ball? It loves it! Want to play a round?
quest.guhs.golf.playing: You're golfing! Your ball is waiting for you. Want to stop? You can do that here too.
quest.guhs.golf.busy: Nyeg, %s is golfing right now. Watch along or come back in a bit!
quest.guhs.golf.elsewhere: You're already golfing on another course!
quest.guhs.golf.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my holes anymore. Is my course broken?
quest.guhs.golf.full: Your pockets are full! Free up one slot for the golf club, then I'll lend it to you.
quest.guhs.golf.start: Yippee! Here's your golf club. Your ball is ready on hole 1. Ready? 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.golf.how: Hold right-click with the club to charge the power bar (the longer, the harder, up to 100%%), look where the ball needs to go and let go to hit. Cheese sauce or out of bounds = 1 penalty stroke. Every hole has three tee mats: green (easy, close to the hole), pink (medium) and red (hard, all the way at the back).
quest.guhs.golf.stopped: You stop golfing. The club goes back in my bag. See you next time!
quest.guhs.golf.walked_away: You walked away from the course. The Golf Guh takes her club back.
quest.guhs.golf.idle: Nyeg, did you fall asleep? The Golf Guh ends your round.
quest.guhs.golf.first_record: Your first round: %s strokes. That's your record right away!
quest.guhs.golf.no_record: Your record stays at %s strokes. Another round?
quest.guhs.golf.first: Your very first round of guh golf! A present from the Golf Guh: 6 golf balls, cheese nibbles and fried cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.golf.club_record: CLUB RECORD! Your name now floats right at the top above the Golf Guh. Chonkily good!
quest.guhs.smul.hello: NYEG! Welcome to the Chonky Food Fest! Hungry? In my arena it rains food. Catch as much as you can in one minute!
quest.guhs.smul.busy: Shhh... someone's munching right now! Watch from the stands, you're up soon.
quest.guhs.smul.elsewhere: You're already munching somewhere else. One feast at a time!
quest.guhs.smul.broken: Nyeg... my arena is broken, the food has nowhere to fall.
quest.guhs.smul.full: Your pockets are too full! Free up one slot for my big munch bowl.
quest.guhs.smul.shop: My little shop! The munch outfit is only sold here. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.smul.go: Here's my munch bowl: walk into the food to catch it. Watch out for the black Mika's Grease! Golden snacks are worth a lot. Ready...?
quest.guhs.smul.invite1: Peckish? Come munch! Just talk to me.
quest.guhs.smul.invite2: Today it's raining cheese nibbles... nyeg nyeg!
quest.guhs.smul.invite3: Who dares? One minute, one bowl, all the cake you can catch!
quest.guhs.smul.cheer.start: Hup hup hup! Chonk chonk chonk!
quest.guhs.smul.cheer.half: 30 seconds left! Keep munching, chonky champion!
quest.guhs.smul.cheer.ten: Ten seconds left! MUNCH MUNCH MUNCH!
quest.guhs.smul.cheer.mika: Yuck! Mika's Grease! Nyeg nyeg nyeg, spit it out!
quest.guhs.smul.cheer.gold: A GOLDEN MUNCH NIBBLE! Everything counts double! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.smul.cheer.combo: Ten in a row! What a chonky tummy!
quest.guhs.smul.mika: Yuck, Mika's Grease! -%s and you're slow...
quest.guhs.smul.bar.gold: GOLD! Points: %s  -  %s s left  -  combo x%s (x2)
quest.guhs.smul.done: Time's up! You munched %s points (%s snacks caught, %s golden, longest combo %s).
quest.guhs.smul.first: Your very first food fest! A welcome present: a guh cake and %s extra munch coins. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.smul.end.super: I've never seen anything so chonky! You're the munch champion of the Guhmension!
quest.guhs.smul.end.good: Wow, what a feast! My tummy is rumbling.
quest.guhs.smul.end.ok: Nicely munched! Come play again, practice makes chonky.
quest.guhs.smul.stopped: You stopped munching (%s points, no munch coins). The munch bowl went back to the Munch Guh.
quest.guhs.vissen.hello: NYEG! Hi, angler! Up for a Guhfish Contest? Three minutes of fishing in my pond, with my very own rod. The heavier the fish, the more points, the more fishing tickets. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.vissen.hello_again: There you are again! The fish have gotten even chonkier. Another round?
quest.guhs.vissen.running: Shhh... fishing in progress! You can still join.
quest.guhs.vissen.watch: The contest is almost over. Watch along, the next one's yours!
quest.guhs.vissen.playing: Keep fishing! %s to go, you have %s points.
quest.guhs.vissen.start: Here's my Guhfish rod. Cast it into the pond as soon as I shout FISH! And watch out for the Mika Catfish... nyeg!
quest.guhs.vissen.no_room: Your pockets are bursting! Free up a slot for my rod first.
quest.guhs.vissen.full: Too late to join, sorry! Wait for the next contest.
quest.guhs.vissen.go: The Guhfish Contest! %s minutes. Right-click to cast, and again when the bobber goes under. Only the pond counts!
quest.guhs.vissen.walked_off: You walked away from the pond: your contest is over.
quest.guhs.vissen.stopped: The contest has stopped. The rod swam back to the Fishing Guh.
quest.guhs.vissen.result: Time! You caught %s fish, good for %s points.
quest.guhs.vissen.winner: You won! +%s extra fishing tickets. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.vissen.record: NEW RECORD: %s points! +%s extra fishing tickets.
quest.guhs.vissen.no_bonnen: No points, no fishing tickets... the Mika Catfish ate them. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.vissen.no_bonnen_early: You stopped early: under %s points there are no fishing tickets. Fish until the end next time!
quest.guhs.vissen.first: Your very first Guhfish Contest! A present from the Fishing Guh: 4 fishing tickets, fried guhfish and cheese nibbles. Chonk!
quest.guhs.vissen.mika: NYEG! A Mika Catfish... -%s points. Throw it back! (Or eat it. Yuck.)
quest.guhs.vissen.golden: %s caught a GOLDEN GUHFISH of %s! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.vissen.heaviest: Your heaviest fish ever: a %s of %s!
quest.guhs.vissen.pond_record: WORLD RECORD! %s reeled in a %s of %s: the chonkiest fish ever!
quest.guhs.vissen.golden_nr: That's golden guhfish no. %s for your collection. Keep it, frame it or gobble it up... WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.eilanden.feed: The Cloud Guh is gobbling it up... %s more nibbles and it'll be chonky enough to trust you
quest.guhs.eilanden.fed: WAHOOG! The Cloud Guh is chonky enough now. Keep feeding it!
quest.guhs.eilanden.tamed: The Cloud Guh floats over to you: it's yours! As long as it's close by, it catches you when you fall. Its cloud hat and cloud collar? They're in the cloud chest on the Little Cloud, at the top of the cloud stairs.
quest.guhs.eilanden.caught_by_guh: Poof! %s catches you like a cloud cushion
quest.guhs.eilanden.no_hurt: Nyeg! You can't hurt a little cloud. Try cheese nibbles instead...
quest.guhs.eilanden.caught: Nyeg, careful! The little clouds catch you...
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.hello: NYEG! Welcome to the Cheese Mine! Deep below us, cheese grows in the rocks. Here, my loaner pickaxe: hack at the yellow veins and the chunks are yours. When you leave the mine, I'll take it back. WAHOOG, happy hacking!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.loan: Here, a loaner pickaxe. Only for inside the mine, okay? Nyeg!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.on_floor: Nyeg, your loaner pickaxe is just lying there on the ground! Pick it up, one per guh, chonk.
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.full: Your pockets are full, nyeg! Free up a slot, then I'll lend you a pickaxe.
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip0: Take the stairs down, or do the WAHOOG Jump: there's water at the bottom, honest!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip1: Tired pawsies? The Cheese Express rides laps through the cheese tunnels. Press the minecart dispenser!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip2: Gold cheese only grows really deep, in the deepslate. The cheese vault in the treasure room loves it...
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip3: A mined-out vein grows back all by itself. Cheese is patient, just like a chonky guh.
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.tip4: Want to look like a real miner guh? I've got a helmet with a lamp, overalls and a hanky for cheese chunks. Not sold anywhere else, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.back: The Miner Guh whistles: your loaner pickaxe goes back to the Cheese Mine. See you next time!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.no_build: Nyeg! Here you may only hack out the cheese veins, not the mine itself.
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.need_pickaxe: That vein is too hard for pawsies: ask the Miner Guh for a pickaxe!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.miner_busy: Nyeg, this miner guh is busy. Nibbling cheese chunks is hard work!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.growing: This vein is growing back. Patience, chonky!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.kluis_need: The cheese vault only opens for %s gold cheese (you have %s).
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.kluis_open: Click-clack... the cheese vault opens! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.cart_ready: There's already a cart waiting here. Hop in!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.cart_new: Toot toot! Hop in and press forward. Sneak to get out.
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.ride_done: WAHOOG! You rode the Cheese Express for half a minute. A real miner guh thing!
quest.guhs.kaasmijn.cart_norail: Nyeg... there are no rails next to this dispenser.
quest.guhs.bieb.hello: Shh... welcome back, reader! All the guh books are lying open on the lecterns in the reading room. Up for a quiz question?
quest.guhs.bieb.hello_first: Ooh, a new reader! Shh, not so loud. Every guh book lies open on a lectern in the reading room: go ahead and read them all. You may take one copy of each book. Just once! Read carefully, then I'll ask you quiz questions. Chonk!
quest.guhs.bieb.taken: You take a copy of '%s'. Happy guh-reading!
quest.guhs.bieb.taken_already: You already took your copy of '%s'. Lost it? The Librarian sells spare copies. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.bieb.right: WAHOOG! Well done! You really read it. Here's a book token.
quest.guhs.bieb.right_again: Right again! You already got a book token for this question, so you get a few nibbles.
quest.guhs.bieb.wrong: Nyeg... that's not it. The answer was: %s. Better read '%s' again!
quest.guhs.bieb.kwismeester: You answered every question right! You're a true Guh Quizmaster. WAHOOG CHONK!
quest.guhs.bieb.collected: New guh book in your collection: '%s' (%s / %s)
quest.guhs.bieb.all_collected: You collected every guh book! A real bookworm guh, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.bieb.altar: The book on the stand is glowing... You found the Secret Guh Book!
quest.guhs.onderwater.hello: Blub blub, WAHOOG! Welcome to the Guh Bubble, the only dry spot at the bottom of the Guh Sea! The giant clams here sometimes have a pearl inside: down here, pearls are money. Need air outside? Swim to the cheese coral, it blows bubbles. And just north of my bubble there's a sunken guh ship... nyeg, I never dared to peek inside.
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip0: A closed clam opens again all by itself. Pearls grow slowly, just like a chonky guh!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip1: With a diving helmet you can stay underwater as long as you like. Only ten pearls, blub!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip2: Cheese coral blows air bubbles. Swim close and breathe in: WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip3: Out in the Guh Sea my wild cousins swim around, the Merguhs. Cheese nibbles, a saddle and hup, underwater riding!
quest.guhs.onderwater.tip4: Goggles, a snorkel and a swim ring: the diving outfit for your guh. Only I sell it, nyeg!
quest.guhs.onderwater.shell_closed: This clam is closed... a new pearl is growing. Come back later!
quest.guhs.onderwater.shell_pearl: The clam opens: a pearl! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.onderwater.no_build: Nyeg! The Guh Bubble is made of glass and mother-of-pearl: hands off, or it'll fill up with water!
quest.guhs.onderwater.ride: Blub! On a Merguh: look where you want to go, jump = up, sneak = get off.
quest.guhs.onderwater.air: Blub... fresh air from the cheese coral!
quest.guhs.gatenkaas.warning.1: NYEEEG! Deep beneath the cheese, someone pricks up their ears... (1/3)
quest.guhs.gatenkaas.warning.2: NYEEEG! There's chewing, closer and closer... Sneak, guh! (2/3)
quest.guhs.gatenkaas.warning.3: NYEEEEEEG! The Chonk Warden is coming! (3/3)
quest.guhs.gatenkaas.vadswaker_wakker: The Chonk Warden crawls out of the cheese! It's blind, but it hears your steps and especially your chewing. Run away or sneak, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.onvahoeg: Bleh... you suddenly feel a lot less wahoog.
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.heks0: Swamp Witch Mika: Nyeg! Hands off my swamp cheese, you chonky thing!
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.heks1: Swamp Witch Mika: Hee hee hee! A Chonk-Be-Gone Potion, just for you!
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.heks2: Swamp Witch Mika: You're way too wahoog for my swamp. Let's fix that, nyeg!
quest.guhs.kaasmoeras.heks3: Swamp Witch Mika: My cheese moths have snatched all your nibbles, hee hee!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.hello: Nyeg, a visitor in the Chonkwood Forest! I'm the Ranger Guh. I look after the giant guh trees and all the guh families. Just look at the baby guhs: they walk in a little line behind their parent. WAHOOG, so cute!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip0: At night the guh families snuggle up together in a guh nest. Put one by your house and your tame guhs will sleep in it too. Chonk!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip1: A wild baby guh is much easier to tame than a big one. With nibbleberries it almost always works, nyeg!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip2: Plant four chonkwood saplings in a square and a giant guh tree grows. Listen closely: those trees giggle sometimes.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip3: Those guh faces in the bark? That's the trees themselves. Give them a tap and their mood changes. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip4: The Mikas want to snatch our nibbleberries, because then the guhs won't get wahoog enough. Nyeg! That's why I'd rather pick them myself.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.boswachter.tip5: My ranger hat and ranger coat? I've got them in guh size too. Your guh will look so chonky!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.hello: Hi hi! I'm the Nibble Picker. I pick nibbleberries from the bushes. Want to trade? For nibbleberries I've got tarts, nests and my picking outfit. Nyeg, no sneaky snacking, okay... *munch*
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip0: Nibbleberries don't prickle, you know. You just walk right through them. Pick them when they're yellow, then they grow back.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip1: Baby guhs love nothing more than nibbleberries. Give a wild baby guh one and it'll often want to come with you right away!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip2: Three nibbleberries, sugar and a cheese nibble: a nibbleberry tart. WAHOOG, now that's chonky!
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip3: I still had a hundred this morning, but... *hic*... I only ate a few. Honest. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.vadswoud.plukker.tip4: Give your tame baby guh nibbleberries and it'll grow up faster. From chonk to wahoog!
quest.guhs.barbecuether.wrong_dimension: Nyeg... this barbecue portal only wants to burn in the Guhmension or the Barbecuether!
quest.guhs.grillguh.hallo1: NYEG, my barbecue! The Mikas pinched my Fire Starter Cubes! And my lovely grill coal frame is broken too, chonk...
quest.guhs.grillguh.hallo2: Will you help me? First the frame: it needs grill coal. Here's how you make grill coal: let cheese sauce flow over a block of coal. Sssss... grill coal! Put the missing pieces back (break out the cracked stones), then we'll talk some more.
quest.guhs.grillguh.frame_hint: The grill coal frame isn't whole yet, nyeg. Tip: cheese sauce over a block of coal = grill coal. The cracked stones in the frame have to come out too!
quest.guhs.grillguh.frame_ok: WAHOOG, the frame is whole again! Now just my Fire Starter Cubes... Those chonky Mikas are in a Mika Camp. Defeat a few: as long as you're helping me, every Mika there drops a Fire Starter Cube.
quest.guhs.grillguh.blokjes_hint: My Fire Starter Cubes are with the Mikas in a Mika Camp (the Super Compass can find one). Defeat a Mika there and bring one back!
quest.guhs.grillguh.blokjes_terug: My Fire Starter Cubes! Nyeg nyeg, they smell like Mika. Now click the grill coal frame with one: light my pit!
quest.guhs.grillguh.aansteken: Click the grill coal frame with a Fire Starter Cube and my barbecue will burn again!
quest.guhs.grillguh.klaar1: WAHOOG, my barbecue is burning again! Smell that? Cheese frying sauce, all the way from the Guhbarbecuether!
quest.guhs.grillguh.klaar2: Here: my secret grill recipe (so you can make Fire Starter Cubes yourself) and a bag of fried cheese nibbles, so your guh gets nice and WAHOOG. My chef's hat? I sell that in my little shop!
quest.guhs.grillguh.recept_weer: Nyeg, did you lose my recipe? Here, I had a spare copy. Don't show it to the Mikas!
quest.guhs.grillguh.mika_drop: The Mika drops a stolen Fire Starter Cube!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip0: Through the portal it's hot, really hot. Cheese frying sauce burns, so no jumping in, chonk!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip1: In the Satay Grove giant satay skewers grow, and in the Sausage Woods there are bratwursts as big as trees. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip2: A bed in the Barbecuether? Nyeg! Way too hot to sleep.
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip3: One step there is eight steps here. Handy for quick travel, if you can stand the heat!
quest.guhs.grillguh.tip4: Cheese sauce on cheese frying sauce turns into grill coal. That's how you can always build a new frame in the Barbecuether.
quest.guhs.rookguh.honger: The Smoke Guh gives you a pitiful look... It wants cheese nibbles! (%s more)
quest.guhs.rookguh.gevoerd: Nom! The Smoke Guh is getting a bit rounder. %s more nibbles until WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.rookguh.vahoeg: WAHOOG! I'm chonky enough again to float home!
quest.guhs.rookguh.niet_slaan: Nyeg! You don't hit a Smoke Guh, you feed it.
quest.guhs.rookguh.gered: You've already rescued %s Smoke Guh(s)! (see the Smoke Guh in your Guhdex)
quest.guhs.aangebrande_mika.wakker: WHO... BURNT ME?! My nibbles! Nyeg, you'll pay for that!
quest.guhs.aangebrande_mika.doorgebakken: NYEG! Now I'm getting really crispy! Spark Mikas, help!
quest.guhs.knabbelbaken.geen_piramide: Put the Nibble Beacon on a pyramid of chonk, cheese or nibble blocks!
quest.guhs.nether_mika.boos: GRRR, nyeg! You hit us. No trading!
quest.guhs.nether_mika.bezig: Nyeg, wait a sec! I'm still sniffing.
quest.guhs.nether_mika.ruil: The Nether Mika tosses you something. Nyeg, fair is fair!
quest.guhs.asguh.blij: The Ash Guh is glowing all over with joy!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.ontsnapt_t: Escaped: %s fish. They're swimming around the pond all chonky now.
quest.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.makkelijk: Take it easy today: the Mikas are still sleepy from their nap. Whack 'em!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.meppen.lastig: Careful, these are the fastest Mikas in the whole Guhmension! And there are sneakily lots of guhs among them: DON'T whack those, okay!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.smul.makkelijk: The Mikas are nice and lazy today: hardly any Mika's Grease is falling. Enjoy your meal!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.smul.lastig: Uh-oh, the Mikas are up top with buckets full of Mika's Grease, and the food falls like a rocket! Will your guh still get wahoog?
quest.guhs.klassiekers.golf.makkelijk: No penalty strokes today, and you get %s strokes per hole. Aim nice and easy!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.golf.lastig: Only %s strokes per hole, from the red mats at the back, with extra slime bumpers and a turbo guh windmill! Wahoog aiming, nyeg!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.makkelijk: Take your time: %s seconds per round, and the jury is extra sweet today.
quest.guhs.klassiekers.beauty.lastig: Only %s seconds per round, and the jury has her strictest glasses on. Show what you've got!
quest.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.makkelijk: The fish are biting very calmly today: you have plenty of time to reel them in.
quest.guhs.klassiekers.vissen.lastig: The fish are as fast as a Mika with a cheese nibble today! Reel them in quick, and hold on tight.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello1: Well hello, dearie! Come to play shuffleboard? Twenty pucks, four gates, and a cup of tea afterwards. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello2: Nyeg nyeg, there's a new little guh! Do you know how it works? One puck in each gate: that's a set, twenty points!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello3: I waxed the board again this morning. Smooth as a cheese nibble in butter! Give it a try.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.hello4: Back in the day I played shuffleboard with my grandpa until late at night. He slid everything into gate 1... but I loved him anyway. Fancy a game?
quest.guhs.sjoelen.playing: You're playing shuffleboard, dearie! Go stand at the head of the board. Want to stop? That's fine too.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.busy: Just a moment, dearie: %s is playing right now. Watch from the bench!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.elsewhere: You're already playing shuffleboard somewhere else!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.broken: Nyeg... where did my shuffleboard go? I can't find the head anymore.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.full: Your pockets are stuffed full! Free up one slot for the pucks, then I'll lend them to you.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.start: Here are your twenty pucks. Go stand at the head of the board... ready? 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.sjoelen.how: Hold right-click with the pucks: the power bar goes up and down. Between Granny's two lines is just right. Look where it needs to go and let go. Walk sideways to slide from the left or right. Gates: 2-3-4-1. Every set (one in each gate) = 20 points!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.stopped: You stop playing. The pucks go back in Granny's little box. See you soon, dearie!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.walked_away: You walked away from the shuffleboard. Granny Nyegshuffle packs up her pucks.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.idle: Nyeg, did you fall asleep? Granny is tidying up the pucks.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.total: %s sets (%s points) + the rest (%s points) = %s points
quest.guhs.sjoelen.first_record: Your first turn: %s points. That's your record right away!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.no_record: Your record stays at %s points. Another game?
quest.guhs.sjoelen.munten: +%s shuffle pucks (1 for your turn, 1 per set, 1 for a new record)
quest.guhs.sjoelen.first: Your very first turn! A present from Granny: cheese nibbles and a little stack of shuffle pucks for at home. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.huis_record: HOUSE RECORD! Your name now floats at the top of the Shuffle House. Granny's knitting a scarf for it!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_100: A HUNDRED! Five in every gate! In a hundred years I've never seen anything so wahoog. Come here, you get a cuddle!
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_goed: Well done, dearie! You can really play. Granny is proud of you.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_aardig: That was pretty good already! Try to give every gate the same amount, then you get more sets.
quest.guhs.sjoelen.opoe_oefenen: Nyeg, never mind! Practice makes perfect. Slide gently, between the two lines.
quest.guhs.doolhof.hello: Good afternoon! I'm Mr. Chonkwiggle, hedge trimmer. The Mikas have hidden cheese nibbles in my maze again, and now the guhs aren't WAHOOG enough... Will you help me find them?
quest.guhs.doolhof.hello_again: There you are again! Up for a new maze? I'll trim you one right away.
quest.guhs.doolhof.busy: Shhh, %s is in the maze! Watch from the lookout guh.
quest.guhs.doolhof.busy_you: You're in the maze! Find those nibbles, chonk!
quest.guhs.doolhof.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my hedge field.
quest.guhs.doolhof.shop: My little shop! With the explorer outfit you get lost in style.
quest.guhs.doolhof.go.makkelijk: A little maze! %s cheese nibbles and %s slow Mika. I'll let it grow... shh, listen!
quest.guhs.doolhof.go.medium: A big maze! %s cheese nibbles and %s Mikas. I'll let it grow...
quest.guhs.doolhof.go.lastig: The WHOLE hedge field! %s cheese nibbles, %s fast Mikas, and watch out for fake nibbles. Here we go...
quest.guhs.doolhof.opzij: Step aside, the hedges are growing! Mr. Chonkwiggle puts you on the square.
quest.guhs.doolhof.klaar_staan: The maze is ready! Find %s cheese nibbles (they float sparkling above the hedges) and run to the exit in the north.
quest.guhs.doolhof.bar_makkelijk: Time %s · %s/%s cheese nibbles · %s still hidden, nyeg!
quest.guhs.doolhof.alles: All the nibbles! Now to the exit, WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.doolhof.nep: Fake! A plastic Mika decoy... +%s seconds, nyeg!
quest.guhs.doolhof.gepikt: Hee hee! A Hedge Mika snatched a nibble and hid it somewhere else! (%s/%s)
quest.guhs.doolhof.tong: The Hedge Mika sticks its tongue out: you didn't have any yet, hee hee!
quest.guhs.doolhof.nog_niet: Hold on! You're still missing %s cheese nibbles. Back into the maze, chonk!
quest.guhs.doolhof.niet_klimmen: No climbing on the hedges, nyeg! Back down you go.
quest.guhs.doolhof.weggelopen: You walked out of the maze. The Mikas keep the nibbles... for now.
quest.guhs.doolhof.te_lang: It's gotten so late! Mr. Chonkwiggle calls you back. Faster next time, chonk.
quest.guhs.doolhof.stopped: Maze stopped. The Mikas are still giggling.
quest.guhs.doolhof.done: Out of the maze (%s)! Time %s, snatched %s times, %s fake nibbles.
quest.guhs.doolhof.end.snel: So fast! All the nibbles are back, the guhs are totally WAHOOG again.
quest.guhs.doolhof.end.ok: Found them, every one! Even faster next time, chonk.
quest.guhs.doolhof.invite1: Who dares to enter my maze? I'll grow one in a jiffy!
quest.guhs.doolhof.invite2: Psst... there are cheese nibbles in the hedges. Coming to look?
quest.guhs.doolhof.invite3: My mustache is tickling: there are Mikas in the maze! Will you help me?
quest.guhs.katapult.hello1: Ahoy, little guh! See that wonky fort across the way? Full of stolen cheese nibbles! Time for a fluffball. FLOOP!
quest.guhs.katapult.hello2: Welcome to the Nibble Catapult! Twelve Mika forts, and you get the fluffballs. They don't hurt anyone, you know: they're just like guhs.
quest.guhs.katapult.hello3: Nyeg! The Mikas built ANOTHER fort. They giggle at me all day long. Let's floop them away!
quest.guhs.katapult.hello4: My eye patch? That's a little heart, just for looks. I can aim just fine! Up for a round?
quest.guhs.katapult.playing: You're flooping! Go stand behind the catapult. Want to stop? You can do that here too.
quest.guhs.katapult.busy: Hang on, %s is flooping. Watch from the wall!
quest.guhs.katapult.elsewhere: You're already busy at another catapult!
quest.guhs.katapult.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my catapult or the fort field. Is something broken?
quest.guhs.katapult.full: Your pockets are full! Free up one slot for the fluffballs.
quest.guhs.katapult.start: To your post behind the catapult! Level: %s. The first fort is being built... 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.katapult.how.makkelijk: Look where the fluffball needs to go and hold right-click: the longer, the harder (up to 100%%). Let go: FLOOP! Easy: 5 fluffballs per fort, and the dotted line shows where it'll fly.
quest.guhs.katapult.how.medium: Look where the fluffball needs to go and hold right-click: the longer, the harder (up to 100%%). Let go: FLOOP! Medium: 4 fluffballs per fort, no dotted line.
quest.guhs.katapult.how.lastig: Look where the fluffball needs to go and hold right-click: the longer, the harder (up to 100%%). Let go: FLOOP! Hard: 3 fluffballs per fort, and it's windy: watch the arrows!
quest.guhs.katapult.mika1: (from across the way) Hee hee hee! These nibbles are ours!
quest.guhs.katapult.mika2: (from across the way) Nyeh nyeh, you'll never hit us!
quest.guhs.katapult.mika3: (from across the way) Hee hee, our fort is the strongest fort in the whole Guhmension!
quest.guhs.katapult.mika4: (from across the way) Fluffballs? Hahaha, those only tickle!
quest.guhs.katapult.mika5: (from across the way) Bring it on, little guh! Hee hee hee hee!
quest.guhs.katapult.stopped: You stop flooping. The fluffballs go back in the basket. See you next time, sailor!
quest.guhs.katapult.walked_away: You walked away from the catapult. Captain Floopguh packs up his fluffballs.
quest.guhs.katapult.idle: Nyeg, did you fall asleep? The Captain is tidying up the fluffballs.
quest.guhs.katapult.fort_klaar: Fort %s (%s): %s  %s points | Mikas %s/%s | chests %s/%s | +%s for your fluffballs
quest.guhs.katapult.record: New record on this level: %s points! (was %s)
quest.guhs.katapult.first_record: Your first round on this level: %s points. That's your record right away!
quest.guhs.katapult.no_record: Your record on this level stays at %s points. Another round?
quest.guhs.katapult.munten: +%s catapult stars (1 for your round, 1 per 9 stars, 1 for a new record; hard +50%%)
quest.guhs.katapult.knabbels: You freed %s cheese nibbles: they're yours! Go get nice and wahoog.
quest.guhs.katapult.first: Your very first round! A present from the Captain: fried cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.katapult.kasteel_record: CASTLE RECORD! Your name now floats at the top above the catapult AND above the Mika Fort. Floop floop hooray!
quest.guhs.katapult.einde_top: What a sharpshooter! The Mikas are still running away giggling. You're the wahoogest catapult guh ever!
quest.guhs.katapult.einde_goed: Nice shooting, sailor! A few more stars and you'll be a captain.
quest.guhs.katapult.einde_oefenen: Nyeg, those Mikas build so sturdy! Tip: hit the little posts at the bottom and everything topples over by itself.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.hello: Hello, sporty one! I'm Coach Wahoogaroo. The Mikas snatched the cheese nibbles, and now the guhs aren't WAHOOG enough... A round of the hexathlon will cheer them up again. Are you in?
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.hello_again: There's my athlete again! Which event shall we do?
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.wacht: You're in for %s! Waiting for the others... or press Start Now!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.doe_mee: %s is starting soon! Press Join In! to be part of it.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.bezig: Shhh, a game is on (%s)! You're up soon.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.shop: My little shop! With the sports outfit you're ready for any hexathlon.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.broken: Nyeg... I can't find my playing fields.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.open: %s! Who's joining? I'll blow the whistle in %s seconds!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.te_laat: Too late, it's already started! Watch along, next time you're in.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.vol: All four lanes are full! Next time, chonk.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.uitnodiging: %s is starting soon (%s s left)! Talk to me to join!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.weggelopen: You walked away from the games. Coach Wahoogaroo whistles you off, nyeg.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.gestopt: The games have stopped for you. All the borrowed bits go back to the coach.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.niet_gehaald: Didn't make it... 0 hexathlon points, but a nice workout, chonk!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.super: %s points! What a champion, the whole tent is cheering: WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.good: %s points, well done! Your guh is nice and WAHOOG.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.ok: %s points! Taking part matters more than winning, chonk. Again?
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.super1: Super job at %s! That earns you extra ribbons.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.end.ok1: Nice workout at %s! Try the Great Hexathlon too.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.hap.mat: Stay on your mat! The nibbles come to you.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.hap.te_ver: Too far away... wait for it to swing back!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.ei.gemist: You missed flag %s! Go back, or the finish won't count.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.ei.valt: Oopsie, your nibble egg fell! Back to the last flag, with a new egg.
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.prik.zoek: Where is that guh board... feel around!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.prik.geen_bord: That's not the guh board... keep feeling!
quest.guhs.knabbelspelen.prik.naast: Pinned! %s blocks from its little bum: %s points.
quest.guhs.elftocht.hallo: Hi, skater! Up for the Eleven Guhtowns Tour? Eleven little towns, eleven stamps, and the ice is slippery as glass. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.elftocht.hallo_bezig: You're already skating, wahoog! Want to stop? You can do that here.
quest.guhs.elftocht.start: Skates on, card in your pocket... First to %s! On my whistle: 3... 2... 1...
quest.guhs.elftocht.vrij: Free skating! No clock, no stamps, just nice gliding. Will you bring the skates back?
quest.guhs.elftocht.al_bezig: You already have skates, nyeg! Finish or stop this ride first.
quest.guhs.elftocht.gestopt: Skates are back. Thank you! Come gliding again soon?
quest.guhs.elftocht.finish: FINISH! %s! Here are %s town stamps (+%s for your speed). You're so wahoog!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.geen_tocht: Hi! I'm the Stamp Guh of %s. Want a stamp? First get a stamp card from Skate Master Guhglide in Guhwarden!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.geen_tocht_s: Hi! I give the last stamp, in %s: the finish! Start with Skate Master Guhglide, close by here.
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.vrij: Free skating has no stamps, nyeg! But a cuddle from %s is always allowed.
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.wacht: Wait for the starting shot, you chonky impatient little guh!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.al: You already have the stamp from %s! On to %s, wahoog!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.volgorde: Nyeg! That's not the right order. First to %s!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.plof: FLOMP! Stamp from %s! %s to go. On to %s!
quest.guhs.elftocht.stempel.kwijt: Huh? I don't even know which little town I belong to anymore... nyeg.
quest.guhs.circuit.hello_new: WAHOOG! Welcome to the Guh Circuit, chonk! I'm Coach Wahoog-Vroom. Three tracks, three levels: Rainbow Road floats through the sky, the Chonk Track has a LOOP and the Cheese Mountain Track goes up the mountain. Take your pick, I'll lend you a racing guh!
quest.guhs.circuit.hello: There's my favorite racer again! Which track will it be today? Your racing guh has already had a cheese nibble. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.circuit.hello_busy: Shh, there's a race on! Take a seat in the stands and cheer real loud: WAHOOG! You're up soon.
quest.guhs.circuit.go_go: Why are you standing here chatting with me? RACE! Your racing guh is waiting! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.circuit.go.regenboog: Rainbow Road! Hold on tight: we're going up in the sky. Drive through the rainbow rings for a WAHOOG boost and jump over the gaps!
quest.guhs.circuit.go.vads: The Chonk Track! Slippery cheese sauce in the hairpin bends, bouncy mushrooms and... THE CHONK LOOP! Just keep running, your racing guh does the rest!
quest.guhs.circuit.go.kaasberg: The Cheese Mountain Track! Up the Nibble Slope: watch out, the Mikas are rolling cheese nibbles down! At the top it's slippery with ice.
quest.guhs.circuit.shop: The circuit outfit! A little helmet, a wahoog racing suit and a checkered flag cape. Only here, only for circuit cups. Then your guh is a real racer!
quest.guhs.circuit.result: Over the line in %s (laps: %s). %s! You get %s circuit cup(s).
quest.guhs.circuit.record: NEW PERSONAL RECORD: %s (was %s)! From now on your ghost rides this race. +2 circuit cups
quest.guhs.circuit.first: Your very first race on this track! A welcome bag: 4 extra circuit cups and a handful of cheese nibbles. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.circuit.track_record: TRACK RECORD! %s raced the %s (%s) in %s: first place on the scoreboard! That race now rides along as the golden ghost!
quest.guhs.circuit.gepikt: Hee hee hee! A Mika Snatcher snatched your WAHOOG speed!
quest.guhs.circuit.rolknabbel: BOOM! A rolling cheese nibble! Up on the mountain the Mikas are giggling...
quest.guhs.circuit.gouden_geest: You were faster than the golden ghost! The track record is yours!
quest.guhs.circuit.pikker.hallo: Hee hee hee! I only snatch speed, you know. Nibbles are for later, nyeg!
quest.guhs.circuit.duwer.hallo: Hee hee, this cheese nibble is about to roll down! Push!
quest.guhs.next.hemel_zoeken: bring the Cloud Shepherd a guh crystal, a golden cheese nibble and a fluff feather
quest.guhs.next.hemel_terug: talk to the Cloud Shepherd or click the Snuggleheart to bring a guh back from the clouds
quest.guhs.reis.hoort_hier: This Travel Guh belongs to this building, nyeg! It's staying right here.
quest.guhs.eilanden.pakje: The Cloud Guh gives you his spare cloud hat and cloud collar (whatever you didn't have yet)! Hold right-click with them to unlock them.
quest.guhs.kermis.first_full: Lap! But your pockets are full: free up 3 slots and you'll get your prize bag after your next lap. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.doolhof.uit_de_heg: Oops, you were stuck in the hedge! Mr. Chonkwiggle puts you on the square.
quest.guhs.circuit.gouden_tijd: A gold-medal time: you're as fast as the legend! WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.race.ended.idle: A minute and a half without a ring? The racing guh dozed off, nyeg. Race over!
quest.guhs.golf.wachtende: %s would like to golf too! Keep playing: if you do nothing for a minute, you have to give up the course.
quest.guhs.golf.te_lang: Nyeg, fifteen minutes on the course and someone's waiting! The Golf Guh ends your round.
quest.guhs.verstop.loopt_al: There's already a game going on %s! You're seeking along (seeking together doesn't count for records).
quest.guhs.verstop.te_lang: Half an hour of seeking (%s of %s found): the guhs come out by themselves. See you next time!
quest.guhs.verstop.idle: You've been standing still for a while, so you stop seeking (%s of %s found). See you next time!
quest.guhs.vissen.loopt_al: This contest is on %s: the first angler picked that.
